description: This file contains functions for backing up and restoring device configuration, including handling checksum validation, file download/upload, and API interactions.

methods.name: backupConfiguration
methods.description: Performs device configuration backup, retrieves device model, fetches backup, adds checksum, and triggers file download.

methods.name: restoreConfiguration
methods.description: Validates and restores device configuration from a provided backup file, including checksum validation, upload, and API commands.
